dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agency personnel within the Department of Veterans Affairs, including acquisition workers, program managers, and leadership positions.
dimensions.evidence: reorganize the acquisition structure of the Department of Veterans Affairs and to establish the Director of Cost Assessment and Program Evaluation

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new internal administrative structures, reporting lines, qualification requirements, and oversight procedures for major acquisition programs.
dimensions.evidence: Each manager appointed pursuant to subsection (a) for a major acquisition program shall report to the Assistant Secretary for Acquisition

dimensions.assessment: Requires existing subdivisions to proportionally fund independent contracts and prioritizes acquisition internship hiring, but does not explicitly appropriate new overall funding amounts.
dimensions.evidence: each organizational subdivision of the Department that enters into a contract under subsection (a) proportionally contributes amounts to fund each such contract

dimensions.assessment: Amends Title 38 of the United States Code extensively by adding new subchapters and sections governing VA acquisition, procurement, logistics, and cost evaluation.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 38, United States Code, to reorganize the acquisition structure of the Department of Veterans Affairs

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent structural reorganization and ongoing reporting requirements, alongside temporary provisions such as internship scaling targets.
dimensions.evidence: not less frequently than once each year, to submit to the Secretary... an annual report on cost estimation

missing_information: Total specific dollar amounts appropriated or saved by the reorganization are not stated in the source text.
importance_detail.rationale: The ARCA Act of 2025 reorganizes the Department of Veterans Affairs acquisition and procurement structure, establishes new executive positions and an independent cost assessment office, and mandates independent verification and validation contracts. The effects are internal to the federal government's administration and management of major acquisition programs.

latest_action.text: POSTPONED PROCEEDINGS - Pursuant to clause 1(c) of rule XIX, the Chair announced further proceedings on H.R. 9237 is postponed.

card.summary: H.R. 9237, titled the "Take Care of America's Veterans Act," addresses a broad range of programs and services administered by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and the Department of Defense. The legislation introduces changes to veteran compensation, education and economic opportunity, health care delivery, administrative organization, memorial affairs, and community care standards.

card.summary: S. 4744, the Take Care of America's Veterans Act, is a comprehensive federal bill addressing veterans' benefits, health care, counseling, Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) personnel, infrastructure, and community care programs. It introduces sweeping updates to disability compensation, education benefits, mental health and suicide prevention programs, community care access standards, and VA administrative and acquisition structures.
